what_it_does: Evaluates how message-passing libraries (MVAPICH-Plus, Open MPI, MPICH, Cray MPICH) behave on AMD MI300A, a processor that combines CPU and GPU on a single chip with shared high-bandwidth memory. Tests both microbenchmarks (point-to-point and collective communication patterns) and real applications (computational fluid dynamics with OpenFOAM and distributed deep learning) to understand performance characteristics of the unified architecture.
